data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features and Metrics
features.description: Highlight key Artemis features such as cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning with real metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning features are clearly explained
Real-time metrics are displayed using Chart.js graphs
Actual data from recent runs is included in the presentation

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Utilize Chart.js to create various data visualizations such as line, bar, area, pie, and radar charts.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics displayed using an 8-stage pipeline chart
LLM cost over time visualized with a line chart
Stage completion rates shown with a bar chart
Success rate trends illustrated using an area chart
Supervisor integration depicted with a pie chart
Code quality metrics presented using a radar chart

features.title: Design Professional Presentation Aesthetics
features.description: Enhance the visual appeal with a gradient background, smooth transitions, and Chart.js animations.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a professional gradient background
Smooth transitions are implemented between slides
Chart.js animations are used to enhance data visualization
Interactive elements are included for user engagement

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file that includes embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for a professional presentation.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file includes all necessary CSS and JavaScript inline
Chart.js is correctly integrated for data visualization
File is self-contained with no external dependencies

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with options for manual navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides automatically advance after a set duration
Users can manually navigate between slides
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive
